events.event_name: New York Transit Museum Bus Festival
events.brand: New York Transit Museum × MTA New York City Transit
events.address: Emily Warren Roebling Plaza, 1 Water Street, Brooklyn, NY 11201
events.what_it_is: The Transit Museum's annual outdoor festival of vintage NYC buses with boarding, hands-on activities, transit trivia and a scavenger hunt.
events.what_is_free: Festival admission, vintage-bus exploration and festival activities are free.
events.caveats: Advance registration is encouraged for planning and enters registrants into a raffle, but the official organizer explicitly says registration is not required. Event runs rain or shine; equipment is subject to change.
events.practical_notes: Saturday Sept. 19, 10 AM–3:30 PM at Emily Warren Roebling Plaza beneath the Brooklyn Bridge.

events.event_name: Slow Summer Reading Party with Reading Rhythms
events.address: Liberty Lawn, Pier 6, Brooklyn Bridge Park, Brooklyn, NY 11201
events.what_it_is: An outdoor social reading party with an hour of reading to live music plus one-on-one and group conversations.
events.what_is_free: The reading party and live-music programming are free and open to the public.
events.caveats: Brooklyn Bridge Park says the event is free and open to the public; RSVPs help organizers plan but are not stated as an admission requirement. Weather or other extenuating circumstances can change the event.
events.practical_notes: Sunday Sept. 20, 1–3 PM at Liberty Lawn on Pier 6. Bring a book and blanket; lawn chairs are not allowed on the lawn.

events.event_name: Return of the Buffalo: Tatanka Owe Akupi — Brooklyn Procession
events.brand: St. Ann's Warehouse × The Walk Productions × KBH Arts
events.neighborhood: Downtown Brooklyn to Brooklyn Bridge Park
events.address: Abolitionist Place to Brooklyn Bridge Park, Brooklyn, NY
events.what_it_is: A public procession of life-size buffalo puppets through Downtown Brooklyn with live music, poetry, ceremonies and performances along the route.
events.what_is_free: The outdoor public procession and route activations can be viewed without a ticket.
events.caveats: This listing is for Saturday's outdoor Brooklyn procession, not a separately ticketed indoor performance. Route timing and artistic activations may move with the procession.
events.practical_notes: Saturday Sept. 19, 2–4:30 PM. The official route runs from Abolitionist Place through Downtown Brooklyn to Brooklyn Bridge Park.

events.event_name: JUNG SAEM MOOL Beauty × Van Leeuwen Mobile Pop-Up
events.brand: JUNG SAEM MOOL Beauty × Van Leeuwen
events.address: Mobile route: Lexington Avenue; 557 Broadway; 21–27 9th Avenue, New York, NY
events.what_it_is: A two-day mobile K-beauty and ice-cream activation celebrating JUNG SAEM MOOL Beauty's U.S. Sephora launch.
events.what_is_free: Guests who follow JSM Beauty on Instagram can receive a special collaboration ice cream. A separate Instagram Story action offers a chance at a full-size Metal Lip Serum, limited to 200 units per day.
events.caveats: The activation is open to the public, but the complimentary ice cream requires following @jsmbeauty_global on Instagram. The full-size lip-serum promotion requires an Instagram Story/tag action and is limited to 200 units per day. Exact Lexington Avenue stop address was not established by the two sources reviewed, so it is not invented here.
events.practical_notes: Both days: Lexington Avenue 11 AM–1 PM; SoHo at 557 Broadway 1:30–3:30 PM; Meatpacking at 21–27 9th Avenue 4–7 PM Saturday and 4–6 PM Sunday.
